messages:
maria_marketing: Quick ask for launch content: can eng/runtime run a focused benchmark showing behavior under bursty & sparse traffic (not just steady-state)? Need raw artifacts + a short slide-ready summary by Thu EOD.

maria_marketing: Key asks: P95/P99 tail during bursts, coldstart heatmap after long idle, tokens/sec during transient spikes, and cost-per-1M-tokens comparison across hosted, dedicated, and quantized variants. Also a 1-paragraph blurb about batching/warmup tradeoffs for the blog.

nate_runtime: Clarifying: define "bursty/sparse" arrival patterns, which model variants, regions, and whether KV cache persists between rapid requests?

maria_marketing: Arrival models: poisson baseline, repeated 60s bursts after 10m idle, and a single 2-min spike after 60m idle. Model variants: flagship float32, int8 quantized, and smaller distilled. Primary region us-west1, one sanity run in eu-west1. KV: persist during rapid bursts, clear after idle to exercise coldstart.

olivia_analytics: We need tokenization.csv (token counts), 20 paired outputs per bucket (float32 vs quant), and raw timing traces so analytics can compute percentiles and quality delta.

sara_infra: We can attach perf traces. Enabling GPU telemetry adds ~10% overhead; skip unless you want it. Also confirm concurrency sweep.
nate_runtime: Plan: concurrency [1,4,8,16,32], token buckets small/med/large (50/35/15 distribution), greedy decode for latency, seed=2024 for determinism, 5m steady-state per point after 30s ramp. We'll run batching off and a burst-tuned small-window batching. Output bundle + presigned links.

maria_marketing: Good. For slides pick the variant with best P95 vs cost tradeoff and one-sentence note about P99 behavior under bursts.

nate_runtime: We'll lock tokenizer to v2-bytepair and include run-config.json, exact CLI commands, CSVs (P50/P95/P99), throughput curves, coldstart heatmap, tokenization artifacts, and outputs.tar.gz with paired examples. ETA: smoke artifacts ~4h, full sweep ~30h.
runtime-bot: bench-run-3023456800 scheduled by nate_runtime  variants: float32|quantized|distilled; arrivals: poisson|repeated-burst|single-spike; concurrency: [1,4,8,16,32]; batching: off|burst-tuned; region: us-west1.
maria_marketing: 30h works. Ping #marketing if anything blocks. Thanks :rocket:
